SELECT s.school_name, s.DOC, 
       (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS diff
FROM schools s
WHERE s.DOC IN (
  SELECT s.DOC
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
AND (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (
  SELECT AVG(s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
)

SELECT school, s.fundingtype 
FROM schools s 
WHERE school IN (
  SELECT school 
  FROM satscores 
  WHERE dname = 'Riverside Unified School District' 
  AND avgscrmath > 400
)
AND s.fundingtype IN (
  SELECT fundingtype 
  FROM schools 
  WHERE county = 'Riverside County'
)
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Name = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  s.school_name, 
  AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_score_in_writing, 
  sc.phone AS communication_number
FROM 
  schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE 
  s.OpenDate > '1991' AND s.ClosedDate < '2000'
GROUP BY 
  s.school_name, 
  sc.phone
ORDER BY 
  avg_score_in_writing DESC

SELECT T1.Street, T1.MailStrAbr
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath = (
  SELECT AVG(AvgScrMath)
  FROM satscores
  ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC
  LIMIT 6
)

SELECT S.State, COUNT(S.enrollment) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM schools S
JOIN satscores AS S ON S.cds = S.cds
WHERE S.DOC = 31
GROUP BY S.State
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name, T1.format 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.name = 'Hour of Devastation' 
AND T2.status = 'Legal'

SELECT T1.manaCost
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id
JOIN sets AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.id
WHERE T3.type = 'Normal' AND T3.frameVersion = 2003 AND T3.borderColor = 'black' AND T3.availability = 'mtgo,paper' AND T3.isFoilOnly = 0

SELECT type, subtypes 
FROM sets 
WHERE language = 'German'

SELECT T1.convertedManaCost AS "Serra Angel", T2.convertedManaCost AS "Shrine Keeper"
FROM cards T1
JOIN legalities T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.name = 'Serra Angel' AND T2.status = 'Legal' AND T1.id = 123

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id 
WHERE T1.convertedManaCost > 5 AND T2.power = '*' OR T2.power IS NULL

SELECT CASE 
  WHEN T1.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL AND T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'
  ELSE 'No'
END AS answer
FROM sets AS T1
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.mtgoId = T2.mtgoId AND T1.name = 'Angel of Mercy'

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM sets AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T2.language = 'Italian' AND T2.translation IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) AS num_cards
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE T1.type = 'Creature' AND T1.format = 'premodern'
AND T1.side IS NULL
AND T1.text LIKE '%This is a triggered mana ability.%'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.borderColor = 'borderless' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage
FROM cards T1
JOIN foreign_data T2 ON T1.id = T2.id

SELECT T2.language 
FROM sets AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 
ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.baseSetSize = 180 
AND T2.language != ''
SELECT T2.language FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
  SUM(CASE WHEN Year(Date) = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM badges
WHERE Year(Date) IN (2010, 2011)

SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation' ORDER BY T1.LastEditDate DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0' THEN FavoriteCount ELSE NULL END) 
FROM postHistory 
WHERE PostId IN (
  SELECT Id 
  FROM comments 
  WHERE CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0' 
  AND UserId = 3025
)

SELECT t.TagName 
FROM posts p 
JOIN tags t ON p.ExcerptPostId = t.ExcerptPostId 
WHERE p.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' 
AND p.CommentCount = 0

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'
SELECT T1.ViewCount FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT T1.Body 
FROM posts AS T1 
JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId 
WHERE T2.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T2.VoteTypeId = 1 AND T2.Id = 6347
SELECT T2.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Score = 17
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k T1
JOIN gasstations T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '201306%'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN CustomerID = 1 THEN Consumption END) / 12 AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
SELECT T2.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Amount = 548.4

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN CustomerID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS Percentage
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Difference
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(
  (Landon_Donovan.overall_rating - Jordan_Bowery.overall_rating) AS REAL) * 100
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
AND T2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
AND T1.date = '2013/07/12'

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_foot_players,
  SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot_players,
  SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(player_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND YEAR(birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT AVG(home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
WHERE country_id IN (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Poland')
AND season = '2010/2011'

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
ORDER BY AVG(T1.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT 
  team_long_name AS team_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Balanced' THEN 'Balanced'
    WHEN buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast' THEN 'Fast'
    ELSE 'Slow'
  END AS speed_class
FROM 
  Team
WHERE 
  team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT T1.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes T1
JOIN Team T2 ON T1.team_fifa_api_id = T2.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE T1.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND T1.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT T1.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2
ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '2011'

SELECT T2.player_name 
FROM Player_Attributes T1 
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T2.birthday LIKE '1970%10'

  d.A18 AS state_unemployment_rate_1996_1_2,

  d.A20 AS state_unemployment_rate_1996_1_2_2,

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.client_id
WHERE T2.birth_date < (SELECT MIN(T2.birth_date) FROM client AS T3 WHERE T3.client_id = T1.account_id)
AND T1.A11 = (SELECT MAX(T1.A11) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.client_id)

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.amount
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.duration > 12
AND T2.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
WHERE status = 'C' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A1 = '1')

SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount
FROM loan
WHERE status = 'C'
AND date - loan(date) < INTERVAL 1 YEAR OR date = loan(date)
SELECT T2.district_name FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.birth_date = '19760129' AND T2.district_id = T1.district_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(DriverID) AS total_drivers,
  COUNT(DriverID) * 100 / COUNT(DriverID) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
  results
WHERE 
  DriverID NOT IN (
    SELECT DriverID 
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Japanese'
  )
  AND year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1 
JOIN (
  SELECT driverId, MIN(time) as time 
  FROM lapTimes 
  GROUP BY driverId 
) AS T2 
ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId 
WHERE T2.time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM lapTimes)

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, T1.points, T1.name
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN constructorStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE T2.wins = (SELECT MAX(COUNT(wins)) FROM constructorStandings)
SELECT T1.positionOrder FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) 
FROM drivers 
WHERE driverRef IN (SELECT driverRef FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008))

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.dob, T1.dob - T2.dob AS age
FROM drivers T1
JOIN results T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId AND T2.raceId = 592
WHERE T2.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.dob - T2.dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.name, T2.points
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN seasons AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year
JOIN races AS T4 ON T3.year = T4.year
JOIN circuits AS T5 ON T4.circuitId = T5.circuitId
WHERE T1.name = 'Lewis Hamilton' AND T2.position = 1

SELECT T1.name, T1.location, T1.lat, T1.lng
FROM circuits AS T1
JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year
JOIN locations AS T4 ON T3.circuitId = T4.circuitId
WHERE T4.country = 'Austria'
SELECT T2.lat, T2.lng FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN circuits AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId)
FROM drivers
WHERE time IS NOT NULL
AND races.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'
AND year = 2007
AND position IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.driverRef
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN drivers AS T2
ON T1.driverRef = T2.driverRef
WHERE T1.nationality = 'American'
SELECT T1.circuitRef FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId WHERE T1.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND T2.url LIKE 'Marina%Bay%Street%Circuit'

SELECT M.first_name, M.last_name, E.expense_description, E.cost
FROM member M
JOIN expense E ON M.member_id = E.link_to_member
JOIN budget B ON E.link_to_budget = B.budget_id
JOIN attendance A ON E.link_to_event = A.link_to_event
JOIN budget B1 ON B.budget_id = B1.budget_id
JOIN expense C ON B1.budget_id = B1.budget_id
JOIN member M1 ON C.link_to_member = M1.member_id
JOIN expense D ON C.link_to_member = D.link_to_member
JOIN budget B2 ON D.link_to_budget = B2.budget_id
JOIN attendance E1 ON B2.budget_id = B2.budget_id
JOIN budget B3 ON B2.budget_id = B3.budget_id
JOIN expense F ON B3.budget_id = B3.budget_id
JOIN member M2 ON F.link_to_member = M2.member_id
JOIN expense G ON F.link_to_member = G.link_to_member
JOIN budget B4 ON G.budget_id = B4.budget_id
JOIN attendance H ON B4.budget_id = B4.budget_id
JOIN budget B5 ON B4.budget_id = B5.budget_id
JOIN expense I ON B5.budget_id = B5.budget_id
JOIN member M3 ON I.link_to_member = M3.member_id

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM attendance AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T2.type = 'Meeting' AND T1.COUNT(event_id) > 10 AND T2.event_name LIKE '%Student_Club%'

SELECT 
  m.last_name, 
  d.department_name, 
  c.college_name
FROM 
  member m
  JOIN major m2 ON m.member_id = m2.member_id
  JOIN department d ON m2.major_id = d.major_id
  JOIN college c ON d.department_id = c.department_id
WHERE 
  m.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

SELECT first_name, last_name 
FROM member 
WHERE department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education' AND position = 'Member'
SELECT cost FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Posters' AND event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.first_name || ' ' || T1.last_name AS full_name, T1.cost AS total_cost
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.link_to_member = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'
SELECT city FROM zip_code WHERE county = 'Orange County, Virginia'

SELECT a.event_name, a.cost
FROM attendance a
WHERE a.cost = (SELECT MIN(cost) FROM attendance)

SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.id) AS percent
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
AND T1.gender = 'Female'

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
JOIN colour AS T4 ON T2.hair_colour_id = T4.id
JOIN gender AS T5 ON T1.gender_id = T5.id
JOIN publisher AS T6 ON T1.publisher_id = T6.id
JOIN alignment AS T7 ON T1.alignment_id = T7.id
WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'durability'
AND T6.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
ORDER BY T3.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Death Touch'
SELECT T2.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T1.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'
SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM superhero

SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS average_weight FROM superhero WHERE gender_id = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, COUNT(T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient T1
WHERE T1.Birthday BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
AND T1.SEX = 'M'
AND T1.CPK > 250

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_platelet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM Laboratory

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE CRE >= 1.5 
AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Thrombosis` = '1' AND T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.`Examination Date` LIKE '1997%' 
GROUP BY T2.SEX 
HAVING COUNT(T1.ID) = (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM Examination AS T3 
                         JOIN Patient AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID 
                         WHERE T3.`Thrombosis` = '1' AND T4.SEX = 'F' AND T3.`Examination Date` LIKE '1997%'))

SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS outpatient,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS inpatient
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis 
FROM Examination 
WHERE GPT > 60 
ORDER BY Birthday ASC

SELECT T2.BirthDate, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Examination T2
JOIN Patient T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T2.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Examination)

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient T1
JOIN Examination T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`HGB` >= 10 AND T2.`HGB` <= 17 AND T2.Birthday > T1.`Birthday`
SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday FROM Patient WHERE UN BETWEEN 29 AND 30

SELECT element 
FROM bond 
WHERE bond_type = '='

SELECT element, label 
FROM atom 
WHERE atom_id = 'TR060'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' EXCEPT SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND element = 'f'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN element = 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen' 
    ELSE 'Other' 
  END AS label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(element) AS ratio
FROM 
  atom 
WHERE 
  atom_id = 'TR006' 
GROUP BY 
  label

SELECT m.label 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN molecule m ON c.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE a.atom_id BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+'

SELECT bond_type, atom_id2
FROM connected
WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'TR%_19'
